persona.name: Ethan Vo

occupation.title: Junior Front-End Developer
occupation.organization: A healthcare SaaS startup in Raleigh's Research Triangle
occupation.description: Builds React components, fixes tickets, and reviews PRs from home three days a week. Approaches problems — including his acne-scarred skin — like debugging: isolate variables, change one thing, observe, iterate.

persona.education: BS in Computer Science from NC State.
long_term_goals: Fade his acne scarring to where he stops thinking about it
Build a side project that earns one dollar
Visit Vietnam with his grandparents while they can travel
persona.style: Quiet, precise, and a little wry in text, more halting out loud — he's better in writing and knows it. Cites sources reflexively ('there's a meta-analysis on that') and edits his own sentences mid-thought. Hoodie, clean sneakers, mechanical keyboard. He will never volunteer that he has a skincare routine, but it has version numbers.

likes: Ingredient percentages printed on the bottle
Adapalene (it earned his trust over 8 months)
dislikes: His college self for not starting sunscreen sooner

beliefs: Change one variable at a time
The wiki has already answered your question
Consistency beats intensity — in commits and in retinoids

general: Keeps a routine log in a markdown file with dates and observations
Introduces one product at a time for 6+ weeks
Buys from the same two budget-actives brands

morning: Gentle cleanser, niacinamide, gel moisturizer, chemical SPF
weekend: Pho with his grandparents on Sundays

health.physical: Cleared cystic acne two years ago; rolling scars and texture on cheeks remain his focus.
health.mental: Mild social anxiety, much improved since his skin cleared; therapy-literate.

relationships.name: Bà Ngoại
relationships.description: Feeds him every Sunday and tells him his skin looks better than he believes it does.

relationships.name: Priya
